topic_title: Adjusting Speed for Poor Weather & Flash Floods
prompt: At what speeds can passenger vehicles begin to hydroplane on water-covered Texas roadways?

options.text: Hydroplaning occurs exclusively at high speeds exceeding ninety miles per hour
Tires cannot hydroplane unless all four tires possess less than 1/32 inch tread
Only commercial 18-wheel tractor-trailers can hydroplane on standing puddles
Hydroplaning can begin at speeds as low as thirty-five miles per hour in rain
